d: When I returned from tour I found this new handpan in my shelf. It’s a scale that I wanted for SO long, and finally my handpan maker had time to build it for me. It’s an iconic old school handpan scale called 'Jibuk' and its structure follows a completely different logic than my usual handpans. I sat down with it and had a hard time feeling it. So I set myself the challenge - to make peace with this instrument and take as much time as necessary, to fully feel it and embrace the sound and vibe.
